args.message:
Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN), per FIN-212

round_money claimed to implement banker's rounding but actually used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing hats like 2.665 to round up (2.67) instead of to
the nearest even cent (2.66). Switch the quantize rounding mode to
ROUND_HALF_EVEN so tests/test_money.py passes.

args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build was failing because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding per FIN-212, but `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring claiming `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Change
- `src/money.py`: switched the `quantize` rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Example
`round_money(Decimal("2.665"))` now correctly returns `2.66` (nearest even cent) instead of `2.67`.

## Testing
CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.
